_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json (which is gitignored) and fill in the real values. Never commit config.local.json; never paste the bot_token into a chat or a log.
_inbox_note:
The Markdown file to append feedback to. It MUST already contain a '## Open' heading (new items are inserted at the end of that section). Create it with e.g.: printf '# Feedback inbox

## Open

---

## Done
' > ~/notes/FEEDBACK-INBOX.md
_photo_note: Optional. Where downloaded screenshots go. Defaults to a photos/ folder next to capture-bot.py. Keep this folder out of version control.
